items.title: Invoice HVW-0388 - Transit grooming fitout
items.body: Hi Jess, van's ready for pickup Saturday. Invoice attached. Thanks for your business! Glenn, Harbourline Van Works, Burnside

attachments.name: HVW-0388.txt
attachments.content:
Harbourline Van Works - Invoice HVW-0388
Customer: Jess Corkum / Fluff Bus Mobile Grooming
Vehicle: 2021 Ford Transit high roof
- Stainless tub w/ ramp and tether rail
- 40 gal fresh tank + 25 gal grey tank
- 6 gal propane on-demand water heater, plumbing + install
- Floor: coin-grip vinyl, drain
- Cabinetry, dryer mount, wiring for 2 outlets
Total: $9,400.00 + HST
Workmanship warranty: 12 months, excludes damage from misuse or user error.

items.author: jess@fluffbusgrooming.example
items.title: water heater leaking BAD
items.body: Glenn the fitting on the hot water line just let go mid groom. I'm in Bedford with a 110 lb Bernese in the tub and theres water all over the floor and down into the cabinet. Had to towel him off and send him home half done. I'm cancelling the rest of today. When can you get me in?? Jess

items.author: glenn@harbourlinevanworks.example
items.title: RE: water heater leaking BAD
items.body: Jess, these lines don't just let go, usually it's because the heater's been run dry or someone's been hanging stuff off the pipe. That'd be user error and not covered. I can get you in Tuesday Nov 3 at the earliest. There's a $180 diagnostic fee to look at it. Glenn

items.author: jess@fluffbusgrooming.example
items.title: RE: RE: water heater leaking BAD
items.body: I have never run it dry and nobody hangs anything off that pipe, its behind a cabinet door. Tuesday is nearly a week away, I've got 6 bookings between now and then I have to cancel. Fine, book me in. But I'm not happy about the $180. Jess

items.author: glenn@harbourlinevanworks.example
items.title: Van done
items.body: Jess, van's ready. Turned out the compression fitting on the outlet was a cheaper one my supplier swapped in, so that's on us, I've replaced all of them on the hot side. I'll knock the $180 off as goodwill. I hear from a couple people you're planning to put us online. That's your right but keep it honest, I've worked hard for my reputation and I'll be reading it. Glenn
